E-Card series · SK

Skyridge

Released May 12, 2003 · 182 cards

Skyridge is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the E-Card series, released in English on May 12, 2003. Its main set has 144 cards, plus 38 secret rares numbered beyond the set (182 in total). It includes 156 Pokémon, 23 Trainer and 3 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

28 illustrators worked on Skyridge. Most cards: Atsuko Nishida (12), Mitsuhiro Arita (12), Hajime Kusajima (11), Kouki Saitou (11), Kagemaru Himeno (9), Kyoko Umemoto (9), Midori Harada (9), Naoyo Kimura (9).
